It features five knobs: bass, treble, volume, gain, and blend. The bass and treble knobs allow for easy yet powerful control over the two-band EQ. The volume knob provides a significant amount of volume, even when the blend knob is set to 100% dry, making it suitable for use as a clean or dirty boost. The blend knob allows for a seamless transition from 100% wet to 100% dry, enabling users to dial in the perfect amount of punch. This pedal is not limited to bass players and can also be used by guitarists looking to add some extra grit to their sound. Summary created by AI from the original source.
